sloka: एवम् उक्त्वा सुमित्राम् सा विवर्णा मलिन अम्बरा ।प्रतस्थे भरतः यत्र वेपमाना विचेतना ॥२-७५-७॥
transliteration: evam uktvā sumitrām sā vivarṇā malina ambarā ।pratasthe bharataḥ yatra vepamānā vicetanā ॥2-75-7॥

translations.english: Having said so to Sumitra, Kausalya trembling and almost lifeless, emaciated, sullied and turned pallid set out for the place where Bharat was.
